description: Declared mutants of the default entity allotter (docs/architecture/target/v2/world-gen-declaration.zh-Hant.md, sections 10 and 11; Design Invariants EI-1, EI-2 in docs/architecture/target/v2/entity-ids.zh-Hant.md; ids ei- and the three moved from the kernel's list with RangeAllotter, which keep their ids). A mutant is killed only when the named test case fails with the expected message.

mutants.what: the allotter wraps to its first id when used up (moved from the kernel's list by v8-arch-gyo2-world-gen with RangeAllotter; carried before from claude/arch-kernel-world-exec 50cb2050 by v8-arch-gyo2-test-debts). Only it catches the no-wrap branch
the allotter gains a Reset (moved from the kernel's list by v8-arch-gyo2-world-gen). Only it catches the absence of a reset
mutants.find:
[[nodiscard]] bool Owns(EntityId id) const noexcept { return first <= id && id <= last; }
};
mutants.expect: RangeAllotter must not have a Reset

mutants.what: RangeAllotter hashes its object bytes, padding included (moved from the kernel's list by v8-arch-gyo2-world-gen with the type; it replaced spa-reserved-short-unchecked). Only it catches the allotter's own hash function
mutants.replace: inline void HashValue(Kernel::Hasher& h, const RangeAllotter& value) { Kernel::HashAsBytes(h, value); }

mutants.what: the Module's prepare function puts the default range even when a value is already there (a carried-over allotter is replaced). Only it catches the 'not over a value already there' half of EI-1
the register row of entity_ids says default=no: a product that lists no unit carries no allotter. Only it catches the Module being carried by default
mutants.find: "The default entity allotter: RangeAllotter registered in every World with a default range",no,yes,
mutants.replace: "The default entity allotter: RangeAllotter registered in every World with a default range",no,no,

mutants.what: EI-3 link set: entity_ids links one more target (a Module or core library). Only it reaches gyo_entity_ids's link set
mutants.replace: target_link_libraries(gyo_entity_ids PUBLIC GYO::Base GYO::Kernel GYO::Orchestration GYO::Math)
